❓ Patient Question: "Heart ki bimariyon se bachne ke liye kya diet aur lifestyle follow karni chahiye? Indian diet mein kya changes laane chahiye?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Yeh bahut important hai. Indian diet mein kuch simple changes laakar aap apne dil ko healthy rakh sakte hain. Sabse pehle, namak aur cheeni kam karein. Processed foods, junk food, aur outside ka khaana avoid karein. Ghar ka bana hua khana khayein jismein fresh vegetables, whole grains (jaise dalia, brown rice, whole wheat atta), aur lean proteins (jaise dal, chana, rajma, fish) shaamil hain. Ghee aur oil ka istemaal kam karein; mustard oil ya olive oil better hai. Trans fats se door rahein. Fruits aur vegetables ko apni diet ka hissa banayein. Regular exercise karein - hafte mein kam se kam 150 minutes moderate exercise, jaise tez chalna, cycling, ya swimming. Stress ko manage karein - yoga, meditation, aur deep breathing se.
